data.title: Housing form due for exchange programme
data.summary: Musterfield Exchange Programme (International Admissions) wrote on 2 February 2026 about your housing application. The completed housing form is due on 03/06/2026, and later forms go on the waiting list.
data.explanation: After you accepted your place, the programme needs you to complete and return a housing form. The letter gives the due date as 03/06/2026, which is 3 June 2026 in the day/month format used in Germany. It could also be read as 6 March, so check the date with the office. Forms that arrive late are put on a waiting list, so you may lose your chance of housing. The letter does not say how to submit the form, so ask admissions if unsure.

items.title: Submit housing form
items.action: Complete the housing form and send it to the Musterfield Exchange Programme by the due date.
items.consequence: Forms that arrive later go on the waiting list.
items.quote: The completed housing form is due on 03/06/2026; forms that arrive later go on the waiting list.
